name: Presence Bar
description: Who is in the document, and what they are doing. Idle people fade, and following someone pins their sentence on the bar.

props.name: title
props.description: The document these people are in.

props.name: people
props.description: Who is here. Idle people have no place. The first active person carries the live dot.

props.name: showIdle
props.description: Show people who are idle. They fade until hovered or followed.

props.name: onFollow
props.description: Called with a person id when follow starts, and null when it stops.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the ring around the person you are following.
